widget.name: content
widget.title: Add a Web Page
widget.html: To add a new web page, enter the desired Title in the form and click the "Add/Check Web Page" button. If the web page does not already exist, you will have the option to select a template. If it already exists, you will be redirected to the existing page where you can make edits.

column.class: small-12 medium-5 large-4 cell callout box

widget.name: content
widget.title: Add Data Records
widget.html:
To add data records to the site, navigate to one of the following pages and click on the "Add" button in the side menu. This will take you to a form where you can enter the details of the record.

Once you have filled out the form, click the "Save" button to add the record to the site. Now you can relate certain records to other relevant content like FAQs, and upload file attachments.
